cvEn:
Shmuel Ben Basat, son of Rivka and Menahem, was born on 7 Adar II 5687 (11 March 1927) in Har-Tov. He graduated with distinction from the village school and helped his parents on the farm. Later he moved to Tel Aviv to learn a trade and became an excellent mechanic.

Shmuel was quiet and modest in his manner and always ready to help his friends. He joined the Haganah in Tel Aviv, took part in its underground operations, and was counted among the Hish of Tel Aviv. In December 1947, when the War of Independence broke out, he returned home to take part in defending his village of birth, and there he gave his life.

Shmuel was killed on 2 Shevat 5708 (13 January 1948) and buried on the Mount of Olives in Jerusalem. His name is inscribed on the memorial erected in the military cemetery on Mount Herzl in memory of the fallen of the Jewish Quarter and of the fighters who fell in the battle for Jerusalem and were buried on the Mount of Olives.
